decisions.reason: Having already shown customer acceptance before the relaunch and apparently remained in the portfolio for several years, this trommel screen is likely above aspiration and a mature German machinery firm would retain it.
As a multi-model mobile shredder line that still fits the firm's core recycling applications, it would likely be kept unless performance clearly fell below aspiration, which is not indicated here.

The stationary electric fine shredder is more niche and thus somewhat more exposed to review, but because it supports the firm's resource-saving stationary-solutions direction, management would probably continue it while monitoring results.
